title: Effects of Confortable Environment, Kangaroo Care and Music Therapy in Newborns in Neonatal Intensive Care Unit
official: Comparative Evaluation Between Preterms and Newborns Undergoing Surgery. Effectiveness of a Multimodal Sensory Intervention on Newborns and Parents' Stress
summary: Creating a comfortable environment, implementing kangaroo care, and incorporating music therapy are crucial interventions for newborns hospitalized in the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU). These strategies not only contribute to the physical well-being of the infants but also play a significant role in promoting their emotional and developmental health.

interventions.name: in the field of rehabilitation and neonatal care: the combination of Kangaroo care method and music therapy

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* newborn hospitalized in NICU

Exclusion Criteria:

* not hospitalized in NICU,
* intubated infants,
* instable clinical condition
